newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted mostly steady on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted mostly steady on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady levels on Wednesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Tuesday.
- One barge, mid-Mississippi River, next week, offered at a steady 120 percent of tariff, bid at 115 percent.
- Five barges, mid-Mississippi River (McGregor and south), one each week August, bid at 120 percent, offered at 135 percent, no comparisons.
- Four barges, mid-Mississippi River, two each weeks of September 21 and 28, bid 2-1/2 points higher at 197-1/2 percent, offered 2-1/2 points lower at 207-1/2 percent.
- Four barges, Mississippi River (Lacon through Savage), one each week September, offered at 215 percent, no bid or comparison.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week December, bid at a steady 160 percent, offered at 165 percent.
